commit_message_on_validation:
A procedure of this activation is called as call_proc calls it: an
argument past its parameters (a pointer prototype that lists more) is
not seen, %PARMS counts it; call_frame checks the count only for a call
by the procedure's own name, as args_for does (OSSILE's OSSPARMS failed
in the first native-diff of this block before that).

Verified by the native unit NPROCPTR under both engines, the program
captured on PUB400 (tools/golden/native87 n87_procptr): %PADDR by name
and by literal, calls as the pointer changes (5, 6), comparisons, a
call through *NULL caught by MONITOR. That call is status 202 on IBM i
but 222 in as4tainr, an interpreter defect (fidelity.md); NPROCPTR does
not check the status.

code, test, test --release, build --release, demo.sh and native-diff
